name: company_financial_facts
description: Dimensioned XBRL facts for one filer — segment, geography or other axis breakdowns that data.sec.gov companyfacts/frames cannot return (those APIs expose undimensioned consolidated totals only). Give a company name (ILIKE match) or a CIK; optionally narrow to one tag (e.g. "Revenues", "LongTermDebtNoncurrent"). Returns each fact's period, value, unit, and — for a dimensioned fact — the segment/member axis it belongs to. Sourced from SEC DERA Financial Statement & Notes data sets, covering only the periods actually loaded (see fsn_coverage).

company.description: Company name, matched with ILIKE (e.g. "Flutter Entertainment"). Omit if passing cik.

cik.description: SEC CIK, with or without leading zeros. Takes priority over company if both are given.

tag.description: Exact XBRL tag name to filter to, e.g. "DerivativeNotionalAmount" (case-sensitive).

name: tag_cross_company_screen
description: Rank every filer in a loaded period by their reported value for ONE XBRL tag — the inverse of a per-company lookup, e.g. "who reported the highest AccountsPayableCurrent this quarter". Give the exact tag name and (usually) a period-end date (ddate, YYYYMMDD). Set dimensioned_only=true to see only segment/geography-level breakdowns rather than consolidated totals.

version.description: Optional taxonomy version, e.g. "us-gaap/2026". Omit to match any version.

ddate.description: Period-end date, YYYYMMDD (e.g. "20260630"). Omit to rank across all loaded periods for this tag.

dimensioned_only.description: true to return only segment/geography-dimensioned rows, skipping consolidated totals.

name: note_text_search
description: Full-text search over tagged XBRL note/footnote text blocks — the disclosure prose behind the numbers (hedge notionals, commitment schedules, related-party narrative) that companyfacts/frames never expose. Give a search phrase; optionally narrow to one company or one note tag. This searches tagged NOTE BLOCKS only, not full filing text — for phrase search over the whole filing document use edgar_filing_text instead.

query.description: Search phrase, e.g. "cross-currency interest rate swap notional".

company.description: Optional company name (ILIKE) to restrict the search to one filer.

tag.description: Optional exact note tag to restrict to, e.g. "DerivativeInstrumentsAndHedgingActivitiesDisclosureTextBlock".

name: fsn_coverage
description: Which SEC Financial Statement & Notes periods are currently covered, and how many submissions/facts/note blocks each holds. Call this first if a lookup returns nothing, to confirm whether the period you need is actually covered.
